elements.text:
Your friend enjoys ice skating and convinces you to try it out. At the rink you put on the skates and step on the ice. You glide forward slowly at first, then faster. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: I'm going to falll over and get injured.
Even if I fall over, I'll probably be fine.
I'm glad my friend invited me today.
I'm having so much fun skating!
Even if I fall, most people won't notice.
